name: web-api-runtime-benchmark
description: Performance benchmark for Express, Hono, and Elysia on Node.js, Bun, and Deno

scripts.benchmark: npm run build:k6 && tsx scripts/run-benchmarks.ts --profile standard
scripts.benchmark:quick: npm run build:k6 && tsx scripts/run-benchmarks.ts --profile quick
scripts.benchmark:standard: npm run build:k6 && tsx scripts/run-benchmarks.ts --profile standard
scripts.benchmark:full: npm run build:k6 && tsx scripts/run-benchmarks.ts --profile full
